spyderco-002.seoTitle: Versatile D2 Folding Knife, Stonewashed Blade OEM Custom EDC | 600 MOQ
spyderco-002.metaDescription: OEM/ODM D2 folding knife with stonewashed blade, 3D printing G10 handle, line lock and ball bearing. Wholesale MOQ 600 pcs. Customize for your brand.
spyderco-002.summary: Stonewashed D2 blade folding knife with 3D printing G10 handle, line lock and ball bearing. OEM/ODM custom options available at 600 pcs MOQ.
spyderco-002.longDescription:
This folding knife features a stonewashed D2 blade for a rugged, wear-resistant finish. The handle is made from 3D printing G10, offering a textured grip and lightweight feel. The knife uses a line lock mechanism combined with a ball bearing pivot for smooth, reliable opening.

Designed for everyday carry, outdoor, and utility tasks, this knife balances durability and function. The D2 steel provides good edge retention, while the G10 handle resists moisture and wear. The ball bearing system ensures quick, consistent deployment.

As an OEM/ODM manufacturer, we offer customization options including blade finish, handle color, logo engraving, and packaging. The minimum order quantity is 600 pcs, making it suitable for private-label brands and wholesale buyers.

Whether you need a reliable EDC knife for your product line or a promotional tool, this model can be tailored to your specifications. Contact us to discuss your custom requirements.
